name: Belong
summary: Telstra-owned budget retail ISP offering NBN broadband and mobile plans; launched Oct 2013 (BELONG AUSTRALIA PTY LTD, ACN 162 699 845).

events.details: Telstra announced Belong as low-cost ADSL2+ ISP Oct 2013 (70GB/250GB plans); wholly owned Telstra brand; BELONG AUSTRALIA PTY LTD registered on ABR 6 Mar 2013. Now primarily NBN + mobile.
